content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIT Mizoram Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Mizoram JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Mizoram is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a BE/B.Tech in specific engineering disciplines with a GATE score or an M.Tech/M.E degree in CSE/IT, ECE, or related fields as per DST/SERB norms.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by a walk-in interview or an online interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 40,700, which includes a basic pay and 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their complete application and required documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Mizoram (NIT Mizoram).

faq.question: Q9. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where is NIT Mizoram located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Mizoram is located in Aizawl, Mizoram, with the pincode 796012.
